newsitem.title: UK: BOC says stg hits H1 performance.
newsitem.headline: BOC says stg hits H1 performance.

text.p: British industrial gases group BOC Plc said on Tuesday that the strong pound hit its performance in the six months to the end of March.

It said that adjusting for translation effects, sales would have been 5 percent higher, pre-tax profit six percent higher and earnings per share up seven per cent. The company reported a slight drop in pre-tax profit to 216.4 million stg, towards the top end of analysts' forecasts. The core Gases business saw underlying profits rise by nine per cent, stripping out currency effects.
